name_zh: 安捷伦 1290 Infinity II 分析型（DAD、ELSD）

dimension_evidence.basis: Documented module envelopes; assembly layout derived as specified per component

components.uncertainty: Manufacturer module dimensions; assembled stack placement, bottle height, installed module SKU and optional thermostat are inferred from facility photograph. Aggregate dimensions are derived, not manufacturer whole-system dimensions.

author: Virtual Lab project contributors; selected component meshes by Zirui Song, Jiadong Zhang, Jiahao Zhang, Xiaojun Chang, Xiaosong Ma, Xiuying Chen (MBZUAI)
license: CC BY-NC 4.0 for reused ChemLab components and derivative assemblies; original project additions retain project terms; manufacturer references remain manufacturer copyright
notes: Visual engineering illustration, not manufacturer CAD or calibrated analytical simulation. No measurement/output capability is provided. Articulation travel and internal module layout are illustrative. ChemLab CHEM-097 is III-generation and CHEM-096 is a 7890B geometry proxy labeled 8890B; their outer housings are never renamed into II/8890. CHEM-099 GPC/RID configuration is not assigned to facility 1290 machines.
axis: X right, Y back, Z up in Blender; standard Y-up glTF export

review.reviewer: Primary agent visual QA, actual final pipeline renders
review.scope: Photo-grounded digital exterior only; dimension/configuration blockers remain enforced independently.

surface_check.method: Actual evaluated vertices to triangles in both directions, closed pose; Euclidean metres; all posed transforms independently checked

assembly.units: m at asset root; local translation units follow accumulated parent scale
assembly.axis_metadata: joint_axis uses Blender Z-up node local coordinates; glTF Y-up equivalent is [x,z,-y]
